settings.headline: Most read this week
settings.note: Ranked by each article's "reads in the last 7 days" field. The numbers are seeded for this demo; a real newsroom would sync them from its analytics through the Raytha API.

settings.headline: Get the Ledger your way
settings.text: Every story is in our RSS and JSON feeds, and each section has its own feed. Saw something we should know about? Send us a tip; an editor reads every message.
